meta.strap: Missiles land in Poland · An AI sell-off sinks Wall Street · COP31 runs into overtime

stories.deck: More than 400 drones and 110 missiles fired overnight; at least 8 killed in Kyiv, bridges, rail and power hit, cuts in 10 regions. Two missiles and a suspected drone came down in eastern Poland; Tusk calls it a deliberate provocation.
stories.title: Russian missiles hit Ukraine — and land in Poland

stories.deck: The S&P 500 fell 3.7% and the Nasdaq 5.28% on Friday, the Dow into correction; Nikkei −5.1%, gold −4.6%, Bitcoin about $57,850. Chip stocks lost $2.3tn of value in a week.
stories.title: AI sell-off pushes Wall Street into correction

stories.deck: Talks in Antalya passed their Friday deadline with no deal; the EU warns the draft is a substantial step backwards on fossil fuels, with nearly 200 nations still split.
stories.title: COP31 runs past deadline, deadlocked on fossil fuels

stories.deck: A 6.7 quake struck at 19:09 local time, 30 km NW of Junín, felt in Lima; no deaths, minor damage to homes, some power cuts.
stories.title: M6.7 quake shakes central Peru

stories.deck: The coalition intercepted three Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh, a third straight night of alerts; tankers were hit by projectiles near the Strait of Hormuz as US–Iran talks stalled.
stories.title: Houthis fire on Riyadh; tankers hit near Hormuz

stories.deck: Burnham, von der Leyen and Costa signed deals on food trade, carbon permits and youth mobility — the biggest step since Brexit.
stories.title: UK and EU sign three post-Brexit deals

stories.deck: Hackers entered the FBI's National Crime Information Center database and a USDA payment system, US media report, amid a run of US outages.
stories.title: FBI database and USDA hacked

stories.deck: Daily pill daraxonrasib made tumours undetectable on scans in one in 12 patients in a trial.
stories.title: Pancreatic-cancer pill shows major progress

stories.deck: The ESA/JAXA craft ends an eight-year, 6-billion-mile journey with orbit insertion at Mercury.
stories.title: BepiColombo reaches Mercury orbit

stories.deck: Two men arrested and a defence attaché expelled over an alleged plot to kill US-Ukrainian rapper Kyivstoner.
stories.title: Denmark expels Russian diplomat over murder plot

stories.deck: Students in 25 countries walked out over living costs, tuition and military spending.
stories.title: Cost-of-living protests spread across Europe

stories.deck: A US judge validated Bayer's $7.25bn deal to settle Roundup complaints, with no admission of responsibility.
stories.title: Bayer pays $7.25bn to settle Roundup cases

stories.deck: Fires burned 7.1 million acres in 2026, 18 times London's area; losses could reach $30bn.
stories.title: Indonesia's forest fires burn 7.1m acres

stories.deck: Trump defended his closeness to Putin and Xi on his return from Asia; Zelensky answered by calling Putin a killer.
stories.title: Trump defends Putin and Xi ties; Zelensky calls Putin a killer

stories.deck: Israeli strikes killed Palestinians in Gaza as violence continued in the West Bank.

stories.deck: Russian strikes on Zelensky's home city killed a 7-year-old and a 20-year-old nurse among the dead.

stories.title: Man convicted of starting deadly Palisades fire

stories.title: Spain heads to 29 Nov election; banking tax planned

stories.title: Nikhil Gupta sentenced to 19 years over murder plot

stories.deck: China sidelined Japan as bilateral ties hit a record low, reports say.
stories.title: Japan sidelined by China as ties hit record low

stories.title: Uganda restricts gatherings and travel over Ebola
